# loopq

> Local CLI for coordinating AI coding agents across Git worktrees with a fragment queue, independent review, gates, and integration.

loopq is a single Python script run with uv. It discovers project configs in
`~/.config/loopq/loops.d/` and keeps queue state under `~/.loops/` by default.
It does not require a hosted service. The current release is `0.2.0`.

## Use loopq

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/README.md): What loopq does, installation, and common workflows.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/docs/quickstart.md): Create a loop and run a manual author and reviewer cycle.
- [Commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/docs/commands.md): All commands, selection rules, and options.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/docs/configuration.md): YAML fields, models, runners, dispatcher, and cron setup.
- [Multi-agent example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/docs/examples/multi-agent.yaml): Several harnesses, and one harness with two models for different tiers.
- [Setup skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/skills/loopq-setup/SKILL.md): Agent-guided project setup with reviewable changes and approvals.

## Develop loopq

- [Agent guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/AGENTS.md): Repository structure and verification for coding agents.
- [Source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/loopq.py): CLI and queue implementation.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvagante/loopq/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release notes.
